purpose: Select a fairness weight on a development population, freeze it, then evaluate once on a disjoint holdout population.

selection_rule.eligibility: For every development regime, the mean paired goodput difference predictive-minus-reactive must be >= -0.001 Mbps.
selection_rule.objective: Among eligible weights, maximize the minimum across development regimes of the mean paired demand-normalized Jain fairness difference predictive-minus-reactive.
selection_rule.tie_break_1: Choose the candidate with the smaller mean paired P95 latency difference across development regimes.
selection_rule.failure_rule: If no candidate is eligible, freeze no weight and report that the candidate family failed the prospective development gate. Do not inspect holdout outcomes for weight selection.

holdout_rule: Evaluate exactly the frozen development-selected weight and the reactive baseline on all holdout seeds and regimes. Do not alter the weight after holdout inspection.
evidence_note: This protocol is designed to separate tuning from evaluation. It is not canonical WOMD evidence and does not remove the need for a larger independent final study.
